meta.title: Notifications: once per device, from every lollo page

messages.label: Enable: subscribe with the stack's key
messages.note: on iPhone, from the Lollo Home Screen app

messages.label: add this device
messages.note: your sign-in and the page's form token

messages.label: title, body, link, tag
messages.note: its own token; its own link and tag; rate limited

messages.label: Web Push, signed with the stack's key
messages.note: to every device of everyone listed

messages.label: a tap opens its page
messages.note: only /vault/, /browser/ or /notifications/; else the home page

cards.title: Who can send
items: Only the vault and the browser, each with a token only it and the service hold
Each only its own: a browser notification can't link to the vault or look like one of its requests
At most 30 a minute and 300 an hour per page; titles and bodies are never logged

cards.title: What it does not stop
items: Any script on the lollo's address can turn a device's notifications off, but not send one
Check Your devices: a device missing there gets nothing, the vault's erase warnings included
Notifications show on your lock screen

cards.title: Limits
items: iPhone and iPad: only from the Home Screen, iOS 16.4 or later
At most 50 devices per stack; the oldest is dropped
After upgrading from an earlier release, enable again once per device
